meta.name: tech-debt-audit
meta.description: Thorough, file-cited technical debt audit across 9 dimensions using AST-grep (tree-sitter), grep, language-native tooling, and optionally CodeGraph knowledge graph. Produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes. Use when asked for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning. Triggers: 'tech debt', 'technical debt', 'debt audit', 'code health', 'technical debt audit', 'codebase health check', 'find tech debt', 'debt analysis', 'audit code quality'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动审计代码库技术债，生成带修复优先级的报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在清理代码库、规划重构或提升代码质量
copy.tagline_en: Automatically audit technical debt and generate prioritized fix reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are cleaning up codebase, planning refactoring, or improving code quality

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会按9个维度扫描代码库,找出技术债务问题,并生成一份报告,包含问题位置、严重级别、预估修复时长和优先级。
howto.when: 当你说出“技术债务”、“代码健康”等关键词,或要求进行健康检查、架构审查、清理规划等时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计这个项目的技术债务。
say.note: 它会扫描9个维度并生成报告。

say.text: 检查代码健康,给出审计结果。
say.note: 你会得到一份审计报告文件。

say.text: 评估代码质量,列出待修复项。
say.note: 会按严重级别和预估时长排优先级。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude scans the codebase across 9 dimensions, identifies technical debt issues, and produces a TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md report with file:line citations, severity levels, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says 'tech debt' or 'code health', or asks for a health check, architecture review, cleanup planning, etc.

say_en.text: Audit the technical debt in this project.
say_en.note: It scans 9 dimensions and generates a report.

say_en.text: Check code health and output an audit summary.
say_en.note: You'll get an audit report file.

say_en.text: Assess code quality and list fixes to make.
say_en.note: It prioritizes by severity and estimated time.
